records.title: Signature mismatch: export

records.issue: documented `(dataset: str | UUID = DEFAULT_DATASET_NAME, format: str = "pydantic", destination: str | Path | None = None, user=None, link_relations: bool = False, include_permissions: bool = False) -> ExportResult | GraphSnapshot`, source `@overload (dataset: str | UUID = DEFAULT_DATASET_NAME, format: Literal["pydantic"] = "pydantic", destination: str | Path | None = None, user=None, link_relations: bool = False, include_permissions: bool = False) -> GraphSnapshot`: BORDERLINE: line 16 is the first of three @overload stubs; against it `format` is documented as str where it declares Literal["pydantic"], and the return as ExportResult | GraphSnapshot where it declares GraphSnapshot. records.issue: documented `(port) -> shutdown() callable, a no-argument function (Callable[[], None])`, source `(port) -> Callable[[], Callable[[], None]]`: BORDERLINE: return type differs: the doc states the runtime return, the no-argument shutdown function, where line 6 annotates Callable[[], Callable[[], None]]; line 19 returns cognee.shared.utils.start_visualization_server(port=port), which returns shutdown, so the declared annotation is the wrong one.
